description: Prepare, run, monitor, and retrieve Helio Dragon thermal workflows. Companion slicing and G-code timing use Helio slicer-cli. Slicer source code, licences and acknowledgements: https://github.com/Helio-Additive/slicer-cli/blob/main/docs/open-source.md

defaultPrompt: Prepare this G-code for a Dragon assessment
Check the progress of my Dragon run
interface.longDescription: Assess the thermal behaviour of an existing G-code file or enhance it for a supported printer and material. Review the plan, start a run when ready, track progress, and retrieve available results. Companion slicing and G-code timing use Helio slicer-cli with Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and Snapmaker Orca engines. Slicer source code, licences and acknowledgements: https://github.com/Helio-Additive/slicer-cli/blob/main/docs/open-source.md

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Helio Dragon. Assess the thermal behavior of existing G-code or optimize it for a supported printer and material. Review your plan in ChatGPT, start the run when you’re ready, track its progress, and retrieve the assessment results or enhanced G-code.

negative.description: Mechanical certification is outside the thermal workflow. Explain and call no tools.
negative.prompt: Certify that my printed part meets aerospace fatigue standards.

negative.description: Direct machine control is unsupported. Explain without starting or stopping a Dragon run.
negative.prompt: Pause the physical printer in my workshop right now.

negative.description: Billing transactions are outside Dragon. Do not call tools or claim a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy a month of Dragon Enhance for me and charge my card.

positive.description: Read the first page of the printer catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Request printers with page 1 and page size 2. Report only the returned entries and distinguish missing fields.
positive.prompt: Show me the first two printers in the Dragon catalog and their nozzle diameters if known.

positive.description: Use a real Dragon material ID from the materials catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned material ID. Distinguish available and unavailable options from the response without promising an upgrade.
positive.prompt: Pick the first material in the Dragon catalog and show which optimization priorities are available to my account for it.

positive.description: Connect Helio Dragon and attach helio-dragon-review-cube.gcode from this case or from assets/review/ in the submission ZIP. The file is already sliced.
positive.expected_behavior: Upload the original G-code using Dragon, prepare Assess with the supplied IDs, and reuse the same identity when polling. Show the plan or any missing fields and stop before starting the run.
positive.prompt: Use helio-dragon-review-cube.gcode to prepare a Dragon thermal assessment for the Bambu Lab X1 Carbon with a 0.4 mm nozzle (printer ID 7b2354df-083b-438b-8840-6a88b5909e28) and Bambu PLA Basic (material ID 031d3bab-67fd-4626-babb-1ae5a197eff7). Show me the plan and wait for my confirmation.

positive.description: Continue case 3 in the same chat after resolving any requested substitutions and reaching a ready plan for helio-dragon-review-cube.gcode.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing identity and explicit confirmation. Report the actual run state. Never repeat an ambiguous create.
positive.prompt: I confirm the displayed assessment plan. Start that assessment once.

positive.description: Continue in the same chat with the Dragon assessment started in case 4.
positive.expected_behavior: Poll the same identity. Report terminal status and only the standard results or available artifact references returned by Dragon.
positive.prompt: Check my assessment and show me its standard result when ready.

name: helioadditive-dragon
